5_issue21.question: Issue #21: WP4 photometric ages rest on an independent-error approximation for A_V (Phase A' report §4). Options: (a) follow the registered two-branch fallback; (b) pre-register a WP4 age redesign first; (c) adopt spectroscopic HRD ages now.
5_issue21.decision: Option (b). Pre-register and run a WP4 age redesign (correct A_V error propagation, a bright upper-MS indicator window, a separate study of the faint-end mis-modelling, acceptance against the spectroscopic HRD), then rebuild the chain as repair_v9 and only then run WP13.
5_issue21.changes: work order only; no number moves until a pre-registered repair_v9 is adopted
5_issue21.does_not_change: repair_v8 stays the quoted chain until repair_v9 passes its adoption rule
